verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable CRM, but the evidence never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Self-hosting and 'own your data' positioning is an adjacent privacy posture, not a documented telemetry opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
